MPtrj.label: MPtrj
MPtrj.notes: Materials Project relaxation trajectories, cleaned and subsampled to about every 10th ionic step; created for CHGNet.

sAlex.label: sAlex
sAlex.notes: Alexandria subsampled by FAIR, filtered to remove prototype overlap with the Matbench Discovery WBM test set.

OMat24.label: OMat24
OMat24.notes: Open Materials 2024 (Meta FAIR): >100M structures from perturbing Alexandria structures.

MatPES.label: MatPES
MatPES.notes: Materials Potential Energy Surface dataset (Materials Virtual Lab + Materials Project), single-point PBE DFT on periodic solids, near-complete periodic-table coverage (all but noble gases and unstable radionuclides).(arXiv:2503.04070)

SPICE.label: SPICE
SPICE.notes: Small drug-like molecules, peptides and ion pairs at wB97M-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVPPD.  A molecular corpus, not a solid-state one.  Cited unversioned by some checkpoints and as SPICE 2 by others; the per-model note records which.

OC20.label: OC20
OC20.notes: Open Catalyst 2020 (Meta FAIR): DFT relaxations of adsorbates on catalyst surfaces, RPBE.

OMol25.label: OMol25
OMol25.notes: Open Molecules 2025 (Meta FAIR), wB97M-V/def2-TZVPD, 83 elements, systems up to 350 atoms.  Counts are the paper's own rounding -- it states 'more than 100 million' calculations over '~83M unique molecular systems' (arXiv:2505.08762), so treat n_structures as a lower bound.

ANI-1xnr.label: ANI-1xnr
ANI-1xnr.notes: Condensed-phase reactive data for C, H, N and O, generated by automated sampling of condensed-phase reactions (doi.org/10.1038/s41557-023-01427-3).

UNEP-v1.label: UNEP-v1
UNEP-v1.notes: Training data of UNEP-v1, a general-purpose potential for 16 elemental metals (Ag, Al, Au, Cr, Cu, Mg, Mo, Ni, Pb, Pd, Pt, Ta, Ti, V, W, Zr) and their alloys.

MDR-Phonon.label: MDR Phonon
MDR-Phonon.notes: Phonon (force-constant) corpus used for the phonon fine-tuning stage of Nequix-MP-1-PFT; supplies curvature information a relaxation-trajectory corpus does not.

OC22.label: OC22
OC22.notes: Open Catalyst 2022: oxide surfaces and adsorbates, total energies (PBE+U).

QCML.label: QCML
QCML.notes: Quantum chemistry reference data for small molecules of up to 8 heavy atoms, covering a large part of the periodic table and several electronic states.  33.5M DFT entries alongside 14.7B semi-empirical ones; the DFT count is the one recorded here.

ODAC23.label: ODAC23
ODAC23.notes: Open Direct Air Capture 2023: CO2 and H2O adsorbed in metal-organic frameworks.

MAD.label: MAD
MAD.notes: Massive Atomic Diversity, the training set of PET-MAD (arXiv:2503.14118).

MatterSim.label: MatterSim
MatterSim.notes: Microsoft Research corpus spanning a wide temperature and pressure range. Unreleased: the count is from the paper, the data itself is not public.

ELEMENTA.label: ELEMENTA
ELEMENTA.notes: Kairos Materials' composition-complete first-principles corpus (VASP, PBE+U, PBE pseudopotentials).

ELEMENTA-Vib.label: ELEMENTA Vib
ELEMENTA-Vib.notes: ELEMENTA expansion set: perturbed structures probing local vibrational environments, the corpus Prophet's third training stage uses.

Alex.label: Alexandria
Alex.notes: DFT relaxation trajectories for ~3M materials (Schmidt et al.).

OpenLAM-internal.label: OpenLAM in-house
OpenLAM-internal.notes: Placeholder for the DeepModeling/OpenLAM domain corpora that the DPA multi-task checkpoints carry heads for (Domains_*, Metals_*, H2O_*, Electrolyte, Hybrid_Perovskite, SSE_ABACUS, ...).  These are not public releases with citable counts; the exact head list is recorded per model in ``training_heads``.

OMC25.label: OMC25
OMC25.notes: Open Molecular Crystals 2025, released alongside UMA.  Listed because UMA trains on it; no separate count transcribed.
